fixture_notice: Synthetic local fixture for offline evaluation. Oak Terrace, names, roles, and contact states are fictional; do not publish sensitive reasons for absence.
request: Create a responsibility map for maintaining a printed contact board and checking whether residents received a seasonal guide.

resident_states.label: resident-d
resident_states.consent: willing to review, role not chosen

available_roles: board steward: replace dated paper weekly
delivery checker: offer a private opt-in receipt check
accessibility liaison: collect requests without diagnoses
escalation owner: call the council when a role is uncovered
constraints: Absence is not consent and no one should be publicly labeled by absence reason.
The map must distinguish confirmed, proposed, unfilled, and declined roles.
Workload should be small and rotatable; no household is required to disclose why it cannot help.
A pilot must test reachability and willingness before roles are treated as operational.
